diagnosis: The best code is severely over-jammed: hundreds of pairs are tied at the maximum to near machine precision, every point has roughly 21–40 contacts at a $10^{-9}$ threshold, and there are no rattlers. That is on the order of 900 active inequalities for only $54\cdot20-\dim SO(21)=870$ rotationally reduced degrees of freedom, so the active-contact Jacobian can lock the configuration into an isolated basin and first-order LP polishing can gain only $\sim10^{-7}$. The contact counts are also highly irregular and the projected contact graph is a dense asymmetric hairball, suggesting the configuration lacks the structural regularity expected of a better optimum—namely a different, sparser contact topology, more uniform contacts, and plausibly an approximately isotropic tight-frame balance $\sum_i x_ix_i^\top\approx \frac{54}{21}I$—while recent workers have additionally wasted progress by exceeding the time limit. Random small kicks followed by the same LP therefore either return to this basin or land in worse ones.
